examples.text: HIDACZ에서는 많은 무기 시스템과 항공기가 집중적으로 운영됩니다.
examples.english: Many weapon systems and aircraft are concentrated in the HIDACZ.

examples.text: HIDACZ 내부에서는 특히 항공기의 움직임이 엄격히 통제됩니다.
examples.english: Aircraft movements are strictly controlled within the HIDACZ.

terms.definitionEn: A method of airspace control that relies on positive identification, tracking, and communicating with aircraft within an airspace, conducted with electronic means by an airspace control element having the authority and responsibility.
terms.definition: 긍정적통제는 항공 공간 내의 항공기를 전자적으로 식별, 추적, 및 통신하는 항공 공간 제어 방법입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 긍정적통제는 전자적 수단을 사용하여 항공기를 추적하고 식별합니다.
examples.english: Positive control tracks and identifies aircraft using electronic means.

examples.text: 긍정적통제 하에서 모든 항공기는 지속적으로 모니터링됩니다.
examples.english: All aircraft are continuously monitored under positive control.

terms.definitionEn: A method of airspace control which relies on a combination of previously agreed and promulgated orders and procedures.
terms.definition: 절차적통제는 사전 합의 및 공표된 명령 및 절차의 조합에 의존하는 항공 공간 제어 방법입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 절차적통제는 사전에 합의된 명령과 절차에 의존합니다.
examples.english: Procedural control relies on previously agreed orders and procedures.

examples.text: 절차적통제 하에서 항공기는 특정 절차를 따라야 합니다.
examples.english: Aircraft must follow specific procedures under procedural control.

terms.definitionEn: The navigable airspace between two points, identified to the extent necessary for the application of flight rules.
terms.definition: 항공로는 두 지점 사이의 항행 가능한 항공 공간으로, 비행 규칙 적용을 위해 필요한 범위로 식별됩니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 항공로는 두 지점 사이의 항법 가능한 공역입니다.
examples.english: An air route is the navigable airspace between two points.

examples.text: 항공로는 항공기에게 안전한 비행 경로를 제공합니다.
examples.english: Air routes provide safe flight paths for aircraft.

terms.definitionEn: The senior command and control element in the Air Force theater air control system’s air, cyberspace, and space operations and coordinates with other components and Services. Also called AOC.
terms.definition: 항공작전센터는 공군 극장 항공 제어 시스템의 공중, 사이버, 우주 작전을 조정하고 다른 구성 요소 및 서비스와 협력하는 최고 명령 및 제어 요소입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: AOC는 공군 전술 공역 제어 시스템의 최고 명령 및 제어 요소입니다.
examples.english: The AOC is the senior command and control element in the Air Force tactical air control system.

examples.text: AOC는 공중, 사이버, 우주 작전을 조정합니다.
examples.english: The AOC coordinates air, cyberspace, and space operations.

terms.definitionEn: The principal air control agency of the theater air control system responsible for the direction and control of air operations directly supporting the ground combat element. Also called ASOC.
terms.definition: 항공지원작전센터는 지상 전투 요소를 직접 지원하는 항공 작전을 지휘 및 제어하는 극장 항공 제어 시스템의 주요 항공 제어 기관입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: ASOC는 지상 부대를 직접 지원하는 항공 작전을 담당합니다.
examples.english: The ASOC is responsible for air operations directly supporting ground forces.

examples.text: ASOC는 전술 공역 제어 시스템의 주요 항공 통제 기관입니다.
examples.english: The ASOC is the principal air control agency of the tactical air control system.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which surface-to-air missile systems engage air and missile threats. Also called MEZ.
terms.definition: 미사일 격전지역은 지대공 미사일 시스템이 공중 및 미사일 위협을 격추하는 정해진 항공 공간입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: MEZ는 지대공 미사일 시스템이 공중 및 미사일 위협을 격추하는 공간입니다.
examples.english: The MEZ is a defined airspace in which surface-to-air missile systems engage air and missile threats.

examples.text: MEZ 내에서 모든 항공기는 특히 주의해야 합니다.
examples.english: All aircraft must be particularly cautious within the MEZ.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which surface-to-air missiles and aircraft are simultaneously employed to engage air and missile threats. Also called JEZ.
terms.definition: 공동격전지역은 표면대공미사일과 전투기가 동시에 공중 및 미사일 위협을 공격하는 정해진 공역입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 공동격전지역 내에 진입하는 모든 항공기는 즉시 신고해야 합니다.
examples.english: All aircraft entering the joint engagement zone must report immediately.

examples.text: 공동격전지역에서 미사일과 전투기가 협동하여 위협을 격파했습니다.
examples.english: Missiles and fighters cooperated to eliminate threats in the joint engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which fighters engage air threats. Also called FEZ.
terms.definition: 전투기 격전지역은 전투기가 공중 위협을 공격하는 정해진 공역입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.english: We shot down an enemy fighter in the fighter engagement zone.

examples.text: 전투기 격전지역에 진입하는 모든 항공기는 전투기 호위 대형을 유지해야 합니다.
examples.english: All aircraft entering the fighter engagement zone must maintain fighter escort formation.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which low- to mediumaltitude surface-to-air missiles engage air and missile threats. Also called LOMEZ.
terms.definition: 저고도 미사일 격전지역은 저고도에서 표면대공미사일이 공중 및 미사일 위협을 공격하는 정해진 공역입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 저고도 미사일 격전지역에서 저공비행하는 적기를 탐지했습니다.
examples.english: We detected low-flying enemy aircraft in the low-altitude missile engagement zone.
We launched missiles in the low-altitude missile engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which short-range air defense weapons engage air threats and which may be established within a low- or highaltitude missile engagement zone. Also called SHORADEZ.
terms.definition: 단거리 방공격전지역은 단거리 대공무기가 공중 위협을 공격하는 정해진 공역으로, 저고도 또는 고고도 미사일 격전지역 내에 설정될 수 있습니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.english: We intercepted enemy aircraft in the short-range air defense engagement zone.

examples.text: 단거리 방공격전지역에 진입하는 모든 항공기는 즉시 대응해야 합니다.
examples.english: All aircraft entering the short-range air defense engagement zone must respond immediately.

terms.definitionEn: A defined airspace in which high-altitude surface-to-air missiles engage air and missile threats. Also called HIMEZ.
terms.definition: 고고도 미사일 격전지역은 고고도에서 표면대공미사일이 공중 및 미사일 위협을 공격하는 정해진 공역입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 고고도 미사일 격전지역에서 고공비행하는 적기를 격파했습니다.
examples.english: We eliminated high-flying enemy aircraft in the high-altitude missile engagement zone.
We launched missiles in the high-altitude missile engagement zone.

terms.definitionEn: 1. overseas — A specifically defined airspace for which air defense must be planned and provided. 2. United States — Airspace of defined dimensions designated by the appropriate agency within which the ready control of airborne vehicles is required in the interest of national security during an air defense emergency.
terms.definition: 방공지역은 해외에서는 방공이 계획되고 제공되어야 하는 정해진 공역이며, 미국에서는 국가 안보를 위해 공중 차량의 통제가 필요한 정해진 공역입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.text: 방공지역 내 모든 항공기는 식별 절차를 따라야 합니다.
examples.english: All aircraft in the air defense area must follow identification procedures.
We detected enemy aircraft in the air defense area.

terms.definitionEn: A geographical subdivision of an air defense area.
terms.definition: 방공구역은 방공 지역의 지리적 분할입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: We must clearly define the boundaries of the air defense region.
There are several air defense sectors within the air defense region.

terms.definitionEn: A geographical subdivision of an air defense region.
terms.definition: 방공분구는 방공 지역의 지리적 분할입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.text: 방공분구에 할당된 전투기가 적 항공기를 요격했습니다.
examples.english: Fighters assigned to the air defense sector intercepted enemy aircraft.
Coordination between air defense sectors is crucial.

terms.definitionEn: A capability that, when added to the basic identification, friend or foe system, provides the means to transmit, receive, and display selected coded replies. Also called SIF.
terms.definition: 선택적 식별 기능은 기본적인 식별친구아군 시스템에 추가되어 선택된 암호 응답을 전송, 수신 및 표시할 수 있는 기능을 제공합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and radio communications.

examples.english: The selective identification feature has been activated.

examples.text: 선택적 식별 기능으로 인해 신호가 강화되었습니다.
examples.english: The signal was enhanced due to the selective identification feature.

terms.definitionEn: An identification based on observation and analysis of target behaviors, including location and trajectory, as well as compliance with airspace control measures. Also called procedural ID.
terms.definition: 절차적 식별은 위치, 궤적 및 항공 공간 통제 조치 준수와 같은 표적 행동의 관찰 및 분석에 기반한 식별입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 절차적 식별을 통해 적 항공기를 확인했습니다.
examples.english: We confirmed enemy aircraft through procedural identification.

examples.text: 절차적 식별에 따라 항공기가 비공격적임을 확인했습니다.
examples.english: We confirmed that the aircraft was non-hostile through procedural identification.

terms.definitionEn: The process of attaining an accurate characterization of detected objects in the operational environment sufficient to support an engagement decision. Also called CID.
terms.definition: 적대적인 물체를 탐지하고 정확하게 식별하는 과정으로, 공격 결정에 필요한 충분한 정보를 제공하는 것
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and briefings.

examples.english: Combat identification is complete. Confirm the enemy aircraft and respond.

examples.text: 전투식별 프로세스를 시작하세요. 모든 항공기를 정확하게 식별해야 합니다.
examples.english: Begin the combat identification process. All aircraft must be accurately identified.

terms.definitionEn: An aircraft patrol provided over an objective area, the force protected, the critical area of a combat zone, or in an air defense area, for the purpose of intercepting aircraft before they reach their targets. Also called CAP.
terms.definition: 목표 지역, 보호해야 할 부대, 전투 지역, 또는 공중 방어 지역에서 적 항공기를 목표에 도달하기 전에 요격하기 위해 제공되는 항공기 순찰
terms.registerNote: Used in mission briefings and radio communications.

examples.english: We are heading out on a combat air patrol mission.
Combat air patrol shifts occur every hour.

terms.definitionEn: In counterdrug operations, contacts that meet the initial identification criteria applicable in the area where the contacts are detected.
terms.definition: 반마약 작전에서 탐지된 접촉 중 해당 지역에서 적용되는 초기 식별 기준을 충족하는 것
terms.registerNote: Used in counterdrug operations and liaison.

examples.english: A track of interest has been detected. Additional information is required.
The track of interest is moving. Track it.

terms.definitionEn: The detection and reporting of enemy activities by an aircraft.
terms.definition: 항공기에서 적의 활동을 탐지하고 보고하는 것
terms.registerNote: Used in operational reports and briefings.

examples.text: 공중 조기 경보 기체는 적의 접근을 감지했습니다.
examples.english: The airborne early warning aircraft detected enemy approach.

examples.text: 공중 조기 경보 시스템이 작동 중입니다.
examples.english: The airborne early warning system is operational.

terms.definitionEn: The urgent communication and acknowledgement of time-critical information essential for the preservation of life and/or vital resources.
terms.definition: 생명을 구하거나 중요한 자원을 보호하기 위해 긴급하게 전달하고 확인해야 하는 시간이 중요한 정보
terms.registerNote: Used in urgent radio communications.

examples.english: A threat warning has been issued. Evacuate immediately.
The threat warning has been acknowledged. Take responsive action.

terms.definitionEn: Direct [active and passive] defensive actions taken to destroy, nullify, or reduce the effectiveness of hostile air and ballistic missile threats against friendly forces and assets. Also called AMD.
terms.definition: 적 항공기 및 탄도 미사일 위협에 대해 우방 부대 및 자산을 보호하기 위해 적을 파괴하거나 무력화하거나 그 효과를 줄이는 직접적인 방어 조치
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and radio communications, formal register.

examples.text: 항공 및 미사일 방어 시스템이 적의 공격을 차단했습니다.
examples.english: The air and missile defense system intercepted the enemy's attack.

examples.text: 항공 및 미사일 방어 훈련을 시작하겠습니다.
examples.english: We will begin the air and missile defense training.

terms.definitionEn: The integration of capabilities and overlapping operations to defend the homeland and United States national interests, protect the joint force, and enable freedom of action by negating an enemy’s ability to create adverse effects from their air and missile capabilities. Also called IAMD.
terms.definition: 본토와 미국 국가 이익을 방어하고, 합동 부대를 보호하며, 적의 항공 및 미사일 능력을 무력화하여 자유로운 행동을 가능하게 하는 능력을 통합하고 중복되는 작전을 수행하는 것
terms.registerNote: Used in strategic planning, briefings, and formal reports.

examples.text: 통합 항공 및 미사일 방어 체계가 구축되었습니다.
examples.english: The integrated air and missile defense system has been established.
Integrated defense is our core mission.

terms.definitionEn: All defensive measures designed to neutralize or destroy enemy forces attempting to penetrate or attack through friendly airspace. Also called DCA.
terms.definition: 적군이 우방의 공중 공간을 침투하거나 공격하려 할 때 이를 무력화하거나 파괴하기 위해 설계된 모든 방어 조치
terms.registerNote: Used in operational reports, briefings, and radio communications.

examples.english: Defensive counterair operations have begun.
Fighters have launched for defensive counterair operations.

terms.definitionEn: A mission at the theater level that integrates offensive and defensive operations to attain and maintain a desired degree of control of the air and protection by neutralizing or destroying enemy aircraft and missiles, both before and after launch.
terms.definition: 공중에서 적 항공기와 미사일을 중립화하거나 파괴하여 원하는 수준의 공중 우세를 달성하고 유지하는 것을 목표로 하는 작전
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 공중전 임무를 위해 전투기 편대를 출격시킵니다.
examples.english: To launch fighter squadrons for air-to-air combat missions.

examples.text: 적의 공중전력에 대한 우위를 확보하기 위해 전략을 수립해야 합니다.
examples.english: We need to develop a strategy to gain superiority over the enemy's air power.

terms.definitionEn: Employment of defense measures to protect limited areas.
terms.definition: 제한된 지역을 보호하기 위해 방어 조치를 사용하는 것
terms.registerNote: Common in written reports and briefings.

examples.text: 지역방어를 강화하기 위해 추가 병력을 배치했습니다.
examples.english: We have deployed additional troops to reinforce point defense.

examples.text: 지역방어 시스템이 완료되어 시설을 보호할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: The point defense system is complete and can protect the facility.

terms.definitionEn: The component commander with the preponderance of air defense capability and the required command, control, and communications capabilities who is assigned by the joint force commander to plan and execute integrated air defense operations. Also called AADC.
terms.definition: 지역항공방어사령관은 항공방어를 주로 담당하는 사령관으로, 합동군 사령관에게서 할당받은 명령, 통제, 통신 능력을 바탕으로 통합 항공방어 작전을 계획하고 실행합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports and briefings.

examples.english: The area air defense commander is developing a defense plan
The area air defense commander is monitoring the surrounding area

terms.definitionEn: Commander, subordinate to the area air defense commander, who is responsible for air and missile defenses in the assigned region and exercises authorities as delegated by the area air defense commander. Also called RADC.
terms.definition: 지역항공방어사령관은 지역 내의 항공 및 미사일 방어 책임을 지는 사령관으로, 지역항공방어사령관에게 위임된 권한을 행사합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports, briefings, and radio communications.

examples.text: 지역항공방어사령관은 미사일 방어 시스템을 검토하고 있습니다
examples.english: The regional air defense commander is reviewing the missile defense system
The regional air defense commander has established a no-fly zone

terms.definitionEn: Commander, subordinate to an area/regional air defense commander, who is responsible for air and missile defenses in the assigned sector and exercises authorities delegated by the area/regional air defense commander. Also called SADC.
terms.definition: 구역항공방어사령관은 할당된 구역의 항공 및 미사일 방어 책임을 지는 사령관으로, 지역/지역항공방어사령관에게 위임된 권한을 행사합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports, briefings, and radio communications.

examples.english: The sector air defense commander is assessing the defended assets
The sector air defense commander is executing the defense plan

terms.definitionEn: A listing of those assets from the critical asset list prioritized by the joint force commander to be defended with the resources available. Also called DAL.
terms.definition: 방어자산목록은 합동군 사령관이 우선순위를 정한 방어 자산 목록으로, 사용할 수 있는 자원으로 보호해야 할 자산을 나열합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports and briefings.

examples.english: Reviewing the defended asset list
Assets were deployed according to the defended asset list

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures designed to destroy attacking enemy missiles or to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of such attack. Also called MD.
terms.definition: 미사일방어는 적의 공격 미사일을 파괴하거나 그 효과를 줄이기 위한 방어 조치입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports, briefings, and radio communications.

examples.english: Strengthening missile defense
Testing the missile defense system

terms.definitionEn: That degree of control of the air by one force that permits the conduct of its operations at a given time and place without prohibitive interference from air and missile threats.
terms.definition: 공중 우세는 한 힘이 특정 시간과 장소에서 공중에서 작전을 수행할 수 있도록 적의 항공 및 미사일 위협을 허용할 수 있는 수준의 공중 통제입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written reports, briefings, and radio communications.

examples.text: 공중 우세를 확보하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다
examples.english: Efforts are being made to achieve air superiority

examples.text: 공중 우세를 유지하기 위해 전투기를 배치했습니다
examples.english: Fighters were deployed to maintain air superiority

terms.definitionEn: Air action by aircraft against hostile targets that are in close proximity to friendly forces and that require detailed integration of each air mission with the fire and movement of those forces. Also called CAS.
terms.definition: 근접항공지원은 항공기가 친밀한 부대와 밀접하게 통합된 공중 작전을 수행하여 적의 목표물을 공격하는 것입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports.

examples.english: Requesting close air support
Close air support halted the enemy advance

terms.definitionEn: An officer (aviator/pilot) member of the tactical air control party who, from a forward ground or airborne position, controls aircraft in close air support of ground troops. Also called FAC.
terms.definition: 전방항공관제관은 전방 지상 또는 항공 위치에서 친밀한 부대를 지원하는 항공기를 통제하는 항공기/조종사 임원입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports.

examples.english: The forward air controller is designating the target
The forward air controller is guiding the aircraft

terms.definitionEn: A qualified (certified) Service member who, from a forward position, directs the action of combat aircraft engaged in close air support and other offensive air operations. Also called JTAC.
terms.definition: 합동공격관제관은 전방 위치에서 친밀한 항공 지원 및 기타 공격 항공 작전을 수행하는 전투 항공기를 통제하는 자격 있는(인증된) 군인입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports.

examples.english: The joint terminal attack controller is controlling the aircraft
The joint terminal attack controller has confirmed the target

terms.definitionEn: A subordinate operational component of a tactical air control system designed to provide air liaison to land forces and for the control of aircraft. Also called TACP.
terms.definition: 전술항공관제반은 항공과 지상 부대에 항공 연락을 제공하고 항공기를 통제하기 위해 설계된 전술 항공 통제 시스템의 하위 운영 구성 요소입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written reports.

examples.english: The tactical air control party is coordinating air support
The tactical air control party has been deployed forward

terms.definitionEn: The senior tactical air control party member attached to a ground unit who functions as the primary advisor to the ground commander on air power. Also called ALO.
terms.definition: 지상 부대와 함께 배치되어 공군력에 대한 주요 조언자를 제공하는 고위 전술 항공 통제 당원의 선임자.
terms.registerNote: Used by military personnel in liaison roles, formal.

examples.english: The air liaison officer coordinates between ground units and air support.
The air liaison officer assessed the effectiveness of the air strike.

terms.definitionEn: A joint force commander-validated target or set of targets requiring immediate response because it is a highly lucrative, fleeting target of opportunity or it poses (or will soon pose) a danger to friendly forces. Also called TST.
terms.definition: 합동군 사령관이 확인한 목표로, 즉시 대응이 필요한 매우 가치 있는 일시적인 기회나 친군에 위험을 초래하거나 초래할 수 있는 목표를 의미한다.
terms.registerNote: Used in tactical briefings and reports, formal.

examples.english: Time-sensitive targets require immediate response.
Immediate action is required as a time-sensitive target has been identified.

terms.definitionEn: An entity that performs a function for the adversary or enemy considered for possible engagement.
terms.definition: 적에게 기능적인 역할을 하는 개체로, 가능한 공격 대상이 되는 것을 의미한다.
terms.registerNote: Common in reports and briefings, formal.

examples.english: It is important to accurately identify the target.
Immediate action is required as the target has been identified.

terms.definitionEn: The process of selecting and prioritizing targets and matching the appropriate response to them, considering operational requirements and capabilities.
terms.definition: 목표를 선택하고 우선순위를 정한 후, 작전의 요구와 능력을 고려하여 적절한 대응을 결정하는 과정이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and radio communications, formal register.

examples.english: Targeting is complete.
We will dispatch a reconnaissance aircraft for targeting.

terms.definitionEn: Unintentional or incidental effect to an entity that would not be a lawful military target in the circumstances ruling at the time.
terms.definition: 적법한 군사 목표가 아닌 개체에 대한 의도하지 않은 또는 부수적인 효과를 의미한다.
terms.registerNote: Used in planning and risk assessment, formal.

examples.text: 부수적 효과를 최소화하기 위해 노력해야 합니다.
examples.english: Efforts should be made to minimize collateral effects.

examples.text: 부수적 효과가 발생할 수 있으므로 주의가 필요합니다.
examples.english: Care is needed as collateral effects may occur.

terms.definitionEn: The estimate of damage composed of physical and functional damage assessment, as well as target system assessment, resulting from the application of fires. Also called BDA.
terms.definition: 화력의 적용 결과로 발생하는 물리적 및 기능적 피해 평가 및 목표 시스템 평가로 구성된 피해 추정이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in post-strike analysis, formal.

examples.english: Battle damage assessment was used to evaluate the effect of the strike.
Additional strikes are needed based on the battle damage assessment results.

terms.definitionEn: An area designated by the appropriate commander into which fires or their effects are prohibited. Also called NFA.
terms.definition: 적절한 사령관이 지정하는 지역으로, 그곳에서 화력이나 그 효과가 금지된다.
terms.registerNote: Used in coordination and safety briefings, formal.

examples.english: Firing is prohibited in no-fire areas.
Care is needed as a no-fire area has been established.

terms.definitionEn: A location in which specific restrictions are imposed and into which fires that exceed those restrictions will not be delivered without coordination with the establishing headquarters. Also called RFA.
terms.definition: 특정 제한이 부과된 위치로, 그 제한을 초과하는 화력은 설립 본부와의 조정이 없이 제공되지 않는다.
terms.registerNote: Used in coordination and safety briefings, formal.

examples.english: Firing must be controlled in restrictive fire areas.
Coordination is needed as a restrictive fire area has been established.

terms.definitionEn: A fire support coordination measure established by the land or amphibious force commander to support common objectives within an area of operation, beyond which all fires are coordinated with affected commanders prior to engagement and, short of the line, all fires are coordinated with the establishing commander prior to engagement. Also called FSCL.
terms.definition: 공통 목표를 지원하기 위해 지상 또는 상륙군 사령관이 설정하는 화력 지원 조정 조치로, 그 선을 넘어서는 모든 화력은 관련 사령관과의 조정이 필요한 반면, 그 선 아래에서는 설립 사령관과의 조정이 필요한 화력 지원 조치이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in planning and coordination, formal.

examples.text: 화력지원조정선이 설정되었으므로 사격 계획 수립이 필요합니다.
examples.english: Fire support coordination line has been established, necessitating fire plan development.

examples.text: 화력지원조정선 너머의 목표에 대한 타격 계획이 수립되었습니다.
examples.english: Targeting plans have been established for targets beyond the fire support coordination line.

terms.definitionEn: A line beyond which conventional surface-to-surface direct fire and indirect fire support means may fire at any time within the boundaries of the establishing headquarters without additional coordination but does not eliminate the responsibility to coordinate the airspace required to conduct the mission. Also called CFL.
terms.definition: 설립 본부의 경계 내에서 추가 조정이 없이 언제든지 전통적인 지상-지상 직접 화력과 간접 화력 지원 수단으로 발사할 수 있는 선을 의미한다.
terms.registerNote: Used in coordination and safety briefings, formal.

examples.english: Firing beyond the coordinated fire line requires coordination.
Care is needed as a coordinated fire line has been established.

terms.definitionEn: The atmosphere, beginning at the Earth’s surface, extending to the altitude where its effects upon operations become negligible.
terms.definition: 항공권역은 지구 표면부터 그 영향이 작전 수행에 미치는 것이 무시할 수 있는 고도까지 확장되는 대기층을 의미합니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 항공권역 내의 모든 항공기는 엄격한 규칙을 따라야 합니다.
examples.english: All aircraft within the air domain must follow strict rules.

examples.text: 항공권역에서 발생하는 모든 사건은 즉시 보고되어야 합니다.
examples.english: All incidents occurring within the air domain must be reported immediately.

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures designed to destroy attacking enemy aircraft or aerodynamic missiles, or to nullify or reduce the effectiveness of such attack. Also called AD.
terms.definition: 항공방어는 적 항공기나 공중미사일을 파괴하거나 그 효과를 줄이기 위한 방어 조치입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in formal military communications.

examples.text: 항공방어 시스템은 적의 공중 위협을 효과적으로 차단합니다.
examples.english: The air defense system effectively blocks enemy air threats.

examples.text: 항공방어는 우리 군대의 주요 임무 중 하나입니다.
examples.english: Air defense is one of our military's main missions.

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures designed to defeat attacking enemy aircraft and missiles and also negate hostile space systems.
terms.definition: 우주항공방어는 적 항공기, 미사일, 그리고 적대적인 우주 시스템을 무력화하기 위한 방어 조치입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in high-level military planning and briefings.

examples.text: 우주항공방어는 우주와 공중에서의 모든 위협을 방어합니다.
examples.english: Aerospace defense defends against all threats in space and the air.
The aerospace defense system must be continuously upgraded.

terms.definitionEn: Air operations to perform interdiction conducted at such distances from friendly forces that detailed integration of each air mission with the fire and movement of friendly forces is not required. Also called AI.
terms.definition: 항공차단은 지상부대와 상세히 통합할 필요가 없는 거리에서 수행되는 공중작전으로, 적의 보급이나 이동을 차단합니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in mission planning and reports.

examples.english: Air interdiction effectively blocks enemy supply routes.

examples.text: 항공차단 작전을 통해 적의 증원 병력을 차단할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: Through air interdiction operations, we can block enemy reinforcements.

terms.definitionEn: A state of aircraft readiness wherein combat-equipped aircraft are airborne and ready for immediate action to reduce reaction time and to increase survivability.
terms.definition: 공중경계는 전투 준비된 항공기가 즉시 행동할 수 있도록 공중에서 대기하는 상태를 의미합니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and status reports.

examples.text: 공중경계 상태에서는 즉시 출격할 수 있도록 준비되어야 합니다.
examples.english: In airborne alert status, we must be ready to launch immediately.

examples.text: 공중경계 중인 전투기는 지속적으로 위치와 상태를 보고해야 합니다.
examples.english: Combat aircraft on airborne alert must continuously report their position and status.

terms.definitionEn: That status in which aircraft on the ground/deck are fully serviced and armed, with combat crews in readiness to take off within a specified period of time after receipt of a mission order.
terms.definition: 지상경계는 항공기가 지상/갑판에 있으며, 보급과 무장이 완료된 상태에서 출격 명령 후 지정된 시간 내에 이륙할 수 있도록 준비된 상태를 의미합니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in status reports and briefings.

examples.text: 지상경계 상태에서는 즉시 출격할 수 있도록 전투기가 준비되어야 합니다.
examples.english: In ground alert status, combat aircraft must be ready to launch immediately.

examples.text: 지상경계 중인 전투기는 지속적으로 상태를 점검해야 합니다.
examples.english: Combat aircraft on ground alert must continuously check their status.

terms.definitionEn: In antiterrorism, examining the capabilities, intentions, and activities, past and present, of terrorist organizations, as well as the security environment within which friendly forces operate to determine the level of threat.
terms.definition: 위협평가는 테러 조직의 능력, 의도, 과거 및 현재 활동, 그리고 친군의 작전 환경 등을 분석하여 위협 수준을 판단하는 과정입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in intelligence reports and briefings.

examples.text: 위협평가를 통해 적의 의도를 정확히 파악할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: Through threat assessment, we can accurately determine enemy intentions.
Threat assessment must be continuously updated.

terms.definitionEn: 1. In air and missile defense, a fire control order used to direct or authorize units and/or weapon systems to attack a designated target. See also cease engagement; hold fire. (JP 3-01) 2. To bring the enemy under fire.
terms.definition: 공격은 공중 및 미사일 방어에서 특정 목표를 공격하도록 단위 또는 무기 시스템에 대한 화력통제 명령입니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and orders.

examples.text: 공격" 명령이 하달되면 즉시 목표를 공격하세요.
examples.english: Upon receiving the "engage" order, attack the target immediately.

examples.text: 공격 명령은 명확하고 정확하게 전달되어야 합니다.
examples.english: The engage order must be clearly and accurately transmitted.

terms.definitionEn: 1. An attack against an air or missile threat. (JP 3-01) 2. A tactical conflict, usually between opposing lower echelon maneuver forces.
terms.definition: 교전은 공중 또는 미사일 위협에 대한 공격 또는 하위 부대의 적대적 기동 부대 간의 전술적 충돌을 의미합니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 교전 중인 전투기는 지속적으로 상태를 보고해야 합니다.
examples.english: Combat aircraft engaged in combat must continuously report their status.
Engagements must be carefully planned and executed.

terms.definitionEn: An authority vested with a joint force commander that may be delegated to a subordinate commander, that permits an engagement decision.
terms.definition: 공격권한은 합동부대 사령관에게 부여된 권한으로, 하위 사령관에게 위임될 수 있으며, 공격 결정에 대한 권한을 부여합니다. ->
terms.registerNote: Used in high-level planning and orders.

examples.english: Engagement authority must be carefully granted.

examples.text: 공격권한은 작전 계획에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다.
examples.english: Engagement authority can vary depending on the operation plan.

terms.definitionEn: The authority and responsibility to engage targets, which may be delegated to subordinate commanders responsible for operational areas. Also called TEA.
terms.definition: 목표공격권한은 작전 지역을 책임지는 하위 지휘관에게 위임될 수 있는 목표를 공격할 수 있는 권한과 책임을 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and orders, formal.

examples.english: Target engagement authority has been granted, so attack the target immediately.
Target engagement authority has been delegated to the squad leader.

terms.definitionEn: An air defense zone established for the protection of key assets or facilities, other than air bases, where weapon systems may be fired at any target not positively recognized as friendly.
terms.definition: 무기자유지역은 항공기나 시설의 보호를 위해 설정된 지역으로, 친구로 확인되지 않은 목표에 대해 무기를 발사할 수 있습니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and air defense contexts, formal.

examples.text: 무기자유지역에 진입하는 모든 항공기는 신원을 확인하세요.
examples.english: Verify the identity of all aircraft entering the weapons free zone.
Shoot down any aircraft flying unauthorized in the weapons free zone.

terms.definitionEn: The degree of readiness of weapons that can be launched to carry out an assigned task, normally expressed in numbers of weapons and numbers of minutes.
terms.definition: 무기준비태세는 할당된 임무를 수행하기 위해 발사될 수 있는 무기 시스템의 준비 상태를 나타내며, 일반적으로 무기 수와 발사까지 걸리는 시간으로 표현됩니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings, formal.

examples.english: Weapons readiness state is currently 5 minutes.
Reduce the weapons readiness state to 2 minutes.

terms.definitionEn: Those minimum actions, including the use of armed force, sufficient to bring a situation under control or to defend against a hostile act or hostile intent.
terms.definition: 최소한의 힘은 상황의 통제 또는 적대적인 행동 또는 의도에 대한 방어에 필요한 최소한의 조치, 무력 사용을 포함합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in liaison and reports.

examples.text: 최소한의 힘으로 시위를 진압하라는 명령을 받았습니다.
examples.english: We were ordered to quell the protest using minimum force.

examples.text: 최소한의 힘으로도 상황을 통제할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: We can control the situation even with minimum force.

terms.definitionEn: An operation planned to demonstrate United States resolve that involves increased visibility of United States deployed forces in an attempt to defuse a specific situation that, if allowed to continue, may be detrimental to United States interests or national objectives.
terms.definition: 힘의 보여주기는 미국 군대의 배치력을 증가시켜 특정 상황을 완화하기 위해 계획된 작전입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in planning and orders, formal.

examples.english: Deploy aircraft for a show of force.
Defuse the tension with a show of force.

terms.definitionEn: A weapon, device, or munition that is explicitly designed and primarily employed to incapacitate personnel or materiel immediately, while minimizing fatalities, permanent injury to personnel, and undesired damage to property in the target area or environment. Also called NLW.
terms.definition: 무력화 무기는 인원이나 장비를 즉각적으로 무력화시키면서도 인명 피해나 재산 피해를 최소화하도록 설계된 무기입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in planning and reports, formal.

examples.english: Suppress the protest with nonlethal weapons.
Nonlethal weapons minimize casualties.

terms.definitionEn: A fire control order used to direct air defense units to stop tactical action against a specified target.
terms.definition: 중지사격은 공중방어 부대에 특정 목표에 대한 전술 행동을 중단하도록 지시하는 화력통제 명령입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and orders, formal.

examples.english: Cease engagement order has been issued.
After ceasing engagement, reconfirm the target.

terms.definitionEn: An emergency fire control order to stop firing on a designated target and destroy missiles in flight.
terms.definition: 일제사격중지는 지정된 목표에 대한 사격을 중단하고 비행 중인 미사일을 파괴하도록 하는 긴급 화력통제 명령입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in emergency situations, formal.

examples.english: Hold fire order has been issued.
After holding fire, destroy the missiles in flight.

terms.definitionEn: A specific region into which any weapon system may fire without additional coordination with the establishing headquarters. Also called FFA.
terms.definition: 자유사격지역은 설치 본부와 추가 조율이 없이 어떤 무기 시스템도 사격할 수 있는 특정 지역입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communication and air defense contexts, formal.

examples.english: Warn all aircraft entering the free-fire area.
Shoot down any aircraft flying unauthorized in the free-fire area.

terms.definitionEn: An immediately available, prearranged barrier of fire designed to impede enemy movement across defensive lines or areas. Also called FPF.
terms.definition: 최후방호사격은 방어선이나 지역을 넘어 적의 이동을 저지하기 위해 즉각적으로 사용할 수 있는 사격 장벽입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in defensive planning and orders, formal.

examples.english: Set up the final protective fire position.
Stop the enemy's advance with final protective fire.

terms.definitionEn: Fire delivered on a target using the target itself as a point of aim for either the weapon or the director.
terms.definition: 직접사격은 목표물을 직접 조준하여 공격하는 화력을 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in combat orders and reports.

examples.english: I will destroy the target with direct fire.
Simultaneously attack the enemy's position with direct fire.

terms.definitionEn: Military action involving the use of electromagnetic energy to control the electromagnetic spectrum or to attack the enemy. Also called EW.
terms.definition: 전자전은 전자기파를 사용하여 적을 공격하거나 전자기 스펙트럼을 통제하는 군사작전을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in military planning and technical discussions.

examples.text: 전자전 능력 향상을 위해 연구 중입니다.
examples.english: We are researching to improve our electromagnetic warfare capabilities.

examples.text: 전자전 대책으로 전자파 차단 장치를 설치하겠습니다.
examples.english: We will install electromagnetic wave blocking devices as an electromagnetic warfare countermeasure.

terms.definitionEn: Division of electromagnetic warfare using electromagnetic energy to attack personnel, facilities, or equipment with the intent of deceiving, disrupting, degrading, or destroying enemy combat capability and is considered a form of fires. Also called EA.
terms.definition: 전자기공격은 적의 전투능력을 저하시키기 위해 전자기파를 사용하여 사람을, 시설, 또는 장비를 공격하는 것을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in operational planning and technical briefings.

examples.english: We will incapacitate the enemy's communication system with electromagnetic attack.

examples.text: 전자기공격 훈련을 통해 대응 전략을 마련하라.
examples.english: Prepare response strategies through electromagnetic attack training.

terms.definitionEn: Division of electromagnetic warfare that protects personnel, facilities, and equipment from any effects of friendly or enemy use of the electromagnetic spectrum. Also called EP.
terms.definition: 전자기보호는 전자기 스펙트럼의 사용으로 인한 영향을 우리 측의 인원, 시설, 장비로부터 보호하는 것을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in technical briefings and reports.

examples.text: 전자기보호 장비를 배치하여 우리 측 장비를 보호하라.
examples.english: Deploy electromagnetic protection equipment to protect our equipment.

examples.text: 전자기보호 대책으로 전자파 방호 장치를 설치하겠습니다.
examples.english: We will install electromagnetic wave shielding devices as an electromagnetic protection measure.

terms.definitionEn: Division of electromagnetic warfare involving actions tasked by, or under direct control of, a commander that searches for, intercepts, identifies, and locates electromagnetic energy. Also called ES.
terms.definition: 전자기지원은 적의 전자기파를 탐지하고, 포착하며, 식별하고, 위치를 파악하는 전자기전쟁의 한 분야입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in operational planning and technical briefings.

examples.english: Locate the enemy's position with electromagnetic support.
We will detect the target using electromagnetic support systems.

terms.definitionEn: Any electromagnetic disturbance that interrupts, obstructs, or otherwise degrades or limits the effective performance of electromagnetic spectrumdependent systems and electrical equipment. Also called EMI.
terms.definition: 전자기간섭은 전자기 스펙트럼에 의존하는 시스템이나 전기 장치의 성능을 방해하는 모든 전자기적 소란을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in technical briefings and reports.

examples.english: Communication was blocked due to electromagnetic interference.

examples.text: 전자기간섭 대책으로 전자파 차단 장치를 설치하겠습니다.
examples.english: We will install electromagnetic wave blocking devices as an electromagnetic interference countermeasure.

terms.definitionEn: Service actions to exploit, attack, protect, and manage the electromagnetic environment. Also called EMSO.
terms.definition: 전자기파작전은 전자기환경을 활용, 공격, 보호, 관리하는 서비스작전을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in operational planning and technical briefings.

examples.english: Secure battlefield superiority through electromagnetic spectrum operations.

examples.text: 전자기파작전 훈련을 통해 대응 전략을 마련하라.
examples.english: Prepare response strategies through electromagnetic spectrum operations training.

terms.definitionEn: The operational, engineering, and administrative procedures to plan and coordinate operations within the electromagnetic environment.
terms.definition: 전자기파관리는 전자기환경 내에서 작전을 계획하고 조정하는 운영, 공학, 행정 절차입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in technical briefings and reports.

examples.english: Manage the electromagnetic environment through electromagnetic spectrum management.
We will analyze the electromagnetic environment using electromagnetic spectrum management systems.

terms.definitionEn: The ability of systems, equipment, and devices that use the electromagnetic spectrum to operate in their intended environments without causing or suffering unacceptable or unintentional degradation because of electromagnetic radiation or response.
terms.definition: 전자기적호환성은 전자기 스펙트럼을 사용하는 시스템, 장비, 기기가 의도된 환경에서 작동하면서 전자기 복사나 반응으로 인해 불필요한 성능 저하를 일으키지 않는 능력을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in technical briefings and reports.

examples.english: Inspect equipment to ensure electromagnetic compatibility.

examples.text: 전자기적호환성 훈련을 통해 장비 호환성을 검증하라.
examples.english: Verify equipment compatibility through electromagnetic compatibility training.

terms.definitionEn: The sum of electromagnetic emissions from all sources that the joint force encounters in a particular operational area. Also called EME.
terms.definition: 전자기환경은 특정 작전 지역에서 합동군부가 마주치는 모든 전자기 방출의 총합을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in operational planning and technical briefings.

examples.english: Monitor the electromagnetic environment to identify enemy movements.

examples.text: 전자기환경 분석을 통해 작전 계획을 수립하라.
examples.english: Formulate operation plans through electromagnetic environment analysis.

terms.definitionEn: The intentional insertion of electromagnetic energy into transmission paths in any manner, with the objective of deceiving operators or causing confusion.
terms.definition: 전자기적 침투는 적의 통신 시스템에 전자기적 신호를 의도적으로 삽입하여 혼란을 일으키거나 오인시키고자 하는 행위이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.text: 전자기적 침투가 감지되었습니다. 모든 시스템을 점검하세요.
examples.english: Electromagnetic intrusion detected. Check all systems.

examples.text: 적의 전자기적 침투로 인해 통신이 차단되었습니다.
examples.english: Enemy electromagnetic intrusion has blocked our communications.

terms.definitionEn: Radiation introduced into the devices or systems for the purpose of learning the functions and operational capabilities of the devices or systems.
terms.definition: 전자기적 탐사는 장치나 시스템의 기능을 파악하기 위해 전자기적 방사선을 삽입하는 행위이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.text: 전자기적 탐사가 시작되었습니다. 모든 장비를 준비하세요.
examples.english: Electromagnetic probing has begun. Prepare all equipment.
Enemy electromagnetic probing signals detected.

terms.definitionEn: A strong burst of electromagnetic radiation which may produce damaging current and voltage surges. Also called EMP.
terms.definition: 전자기파는 강한 전자기적 방사선이 발생하여 장비에 손상을 줄 수 있는 현상이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 전자기펄스가 발생할 수 있습니다. 모든 전자 장비를 보호하세요.
examples.english: Electromagnetic pulse may occur. Protect all electronic equipment.

examples.text: 적의 전자기펄스 공격으로 인해 시스템이 손상되었습니다.
examples.english: Systems damaged due to enemy EMP attack.

terms.definitionEn: The controlled use of electromagnetic, acoustic, or other emitters to optimize command and control capabilities and minimize detection by enemy sensors, mutual interference among friendly systems, and enemy interference with the ability to execute a military deception plan. Also called EMCON.
terms.definition: 전자기적 방출 통제는 적의 탐지에 노출되지 않도록 전자기적, 음향적, 기타 방출을 최적화하는 행위이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and orders.

examples.english: Implement emission control measures.

examples.text: 전자기적 방출 통제 중입니다. 모든 통신을 최소화하세요.
examples.english: Emission control in effect. Minimize all communications.

terms.definitionEn: This portion of communications security designed to deny unauthorized persons information of value as a result of intercept and analysis of compromising emanations from cryptographic equipment and telecommunications systems.
terms.definition: 전자기적 방출 보안은 암호 장비나 통신 시스템에서 발생하는 유출을 방지하여 정보를 보호하는 행위이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports and briefings.

examples.english: Strengthen emission security.
Emission security violation detected.

terms.definitionEn: Protective measures to deny unauthorized access to information of value derived from use of communications systems. Also called COMSEC.
terms.definition: 통신보안은 통신 시스템을 통해 유출되는 정보를 보호하는 행위이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications, reports, and orders.

examples.english: Maintain communications security.
Communications security compromised. Take immediate action.

terms.definitionEn: That portion of communications security designed to protect communications from interception and exploitation by means other than cryptanalysis.
terms.definition: 전송보안은 암호 해독을 통하지 않은 방법으로 통신을 보호하는 행위이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications, reports, and orders.

examples.english: Use encrypted communications for transmission security.

examples.text: 전송보안 조치로 인해 통신 지연이 발생할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: Communication delays may occur due to transmission security measures.

terms.definitionEn: A list of TABOO, PROTECTED, and GUARDED functions, nets, and frequencies, sorted by time and location, and limited to the minimum number of frequencies necessary for friendly forces to accomplish objectives. Also called JRFL.
terms.definition: 합동제한주파수목록은 특정 시간과 장소에 필요한 최소한의 주파수를 포함하여, TABOO, PROTECTED, GUARDED 기능을 나열한 목록이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in reports, briefings, and orders.

examples.english: Check the joint restricted frequency list.
Change frequencies according to the joint restricted frequency list.

terms.definitionEn: Friendly frequencies used for a particular operation, identified and protected for a period of time to prevent them from being inadvertently jammed by friendly forces while active electromagnetic warfare operations are directed against hostile forces.
terms.definition: 보호주파수는 특정 작전에 사용되는 우호적인 주파수로, 일정 기간 동안 우발적인 방해로부터 보호된다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications, reports, and orders.

examples.english: Using protected frequencies.
Protected frequencies changed. Apply new frequencies.

terms.definitionEn: The dynamic planning, directing, monitoring, and assessing of operations in the electromagnetic spectrum in support of the commander’s concept of the operation. Also called EMBM.
terms.definition: 전자기적 전투관리는 전자기 스펙트럼에서 작전을 지원하기 위해 동적으로 계획, 지시, 모니터링 및 평가하는 행위이다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and orders.

examples.english: Initiate electromagnetic battle management.
Electromagnetic battle management system is operational.

terms.definitionEn: The characteristics of a system that cause it to suffer a performance degradation when subjected to electromagnetic environmental effects.
terms.definition: 시스템이 전자기적 환경 효과에 노출될 때 성능이 저하되는 특성
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and briefings.

examples.text: 전자기적 취약성이 시스템의 성능 저하를 일으킬 수 있습니다.
examples.english: Electromagnetic vulnerability can cause system performance degradation.

examples.text: 이 시스템은 전자기적 취약성에 대한 테스트를 통과했습니다.
examples.english: This system passed the electromagnetic vulnerability test.

terms.definitionEn: Action taken to protect personnel, facilities, and equipment against undesirable effects of electromagnetic energy.
terms.definition: 전자기적 에너지의 불필요한 영향을 인원, 시설, 장비로부터 보호하기 위한 조치
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and briefings.

examples.text: 전자기적 경화를 통해 장비를 보호해야 합니다.
examples.english: We must protect equipment through electromagnetic hardening.

examples.text: 이 시설은 전자기적 경화 조치를 완료했습니다.
examples.english: This facility has completed electromagnetic hardening measures.

terms.definitionEn: The employment of devices and techniques that impair the effectiveness of enemy actions.
terms.definition: 적의 활동을 저해하기 위해 장치와 기법을 사용하는 것
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 대응조치를 통해 적의 효과를 저하시킬 수 있습니다.
examples.english: Countermeasures can impair the enemy's effectiveness.

examples.text: 우리는 대응조치를 강화하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
examples.english: We are working to strengthen our countermeasures.

terms.definitionEn: A device or technique employing electrooptical-infrared materials or technology to impair the effectiveness of enemy activity.
terms.definition: 전자기적-광학적-적외선 기술을 사용하여 적의 활동을 저해하는 장치 또는 기법
terms.registerNote: Used in technical reports and briefings.

examples.english: Electro-optical-infrared countermeasures impair enemy activity.

examples.text: 이 장비는 전자기적-광학적-적외선 대응조치를 포함하고 있습니다.
examples.english: This equipment includes electro-optical-infrared countermeasures.

terms.definitionEn: That degree of control in the electromagnetic spectrum that permits the conduct of operations at a given time and place without prohibitive interference, while affecting the threat’s ability to do the same.
terms.definition: 특정 시간과 장소에서 작전을 수행할 수 있도록 전자기적 스펙트럼을 통제하는 정도, 동시에 적의 능력을 저해하는 것
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 전자기적 스펙트럼 우세를 확보하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다.
examples.english: We are working to secure electromagnetic spectrum superiority.

examples.text: 이 작전은 전자기적 스펙트럼 우세를 요구합니다.
examples.english: This operation requires electromagnetic spectrum superiority.

terms.definitionEn: An air defense zone established around an air base and limited to the engagement envelope of short-range air defense weapons systems defending that base.
terms.definition: 단거리 공중방어 무기 시스템의 사정거리 내에서 공군 기지를 보호하기 위해 설정된 공중방어 구역
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and radio communications.

examples.text: 기지방어구역 내의 모든 활동을 모니터링 중입니다.
examples.english: Monitoring all activities within the base defense zone.
Coordinating to expand the base defense zone.

terms.definitionEn: A line that delineates the surface area of a base for the purpose of facilitating coordination and deconfliction of operations between adjacent units, formations, or areas.
terms.definition: 인접 부대, 부대, 또는 지역 간 조율을 용이하게 하기 위해 기지의 표면 영역을 구분하는 선
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and written instructions.

examples.english: Do not cross the base boundary.
We must clearly mark the base boundary.

terms.definitionEn: A collection of bases, geographically grouped for mutual protection and ease of command and control.
terms.definition: 상호 보호와 명령 및 통제를 쉽게 하기 위해 지리적으로 그룹화된 기지 모음
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: 기지군집은 상호 보호와 명령 통제에 도움이 됩니다.
examples.english: Base clusters aid in mutual protection and command control.

examples.text: 이 기지군집은 세 개의 기지로 구성됩니다.
examples.english: This base cluster consists of three bases.

terms.definitionEn: A command and control facility that serves as the base cluster commander’s focal point for defense and security of the base cluster. Also called BCOC.
terms.definition: 기지 군집 사령관의 방어 및 보안에 대한 중심점이 되는 명령 및 통제 시설
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports.

examples.text: BCOC는 기지군집의 방어와 보안에 중점을 두고 있습니다.
examples.english: BCOC focuses on the defense and security of the base cluster.
Coordinating with BCOC to plan operations.

terms.definitionEn: That part of security concerned with physical measures designed to safeguard personnel; to prevent unauthorized access to equipment, installations, material, and documents; and to safeguard them against espionage, sabotage, damage, and theft.
terms.definition: 인원 보호, 장비 및 시설에 대한 무단 접근 방지, 간첩 활동, 파괴, 손상 및 도난으로부터 보호하기 위한 물리적 조치
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, radio communications, and written instructions.

examples.english: We are working to enhance physical security.
Comply with physical security measures.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Measures taken by a military unit, activity, or installation to protect itself against all acts designed to, or which may, impair its effectiveness. (JP 3-10) 2. A condition that results from the establishment and maintenance of protective measures that ensure a state of inviolability from hostile acts or influences. (JP 3-10) 3. Measures taken to prevent unauthorized persons from having access to information safeguarded in the interest of the nation.
terms.definition: 군사 부대나 시설이 적의 공격이나 간섭으로부터 안전하게 보호되는 상태를 유지하기 위해 취하는 조치입니다. 정보의 보안도 포함됩니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: Security must be strengthened.
Check the security status.

terms.definitionEn: A highly mobile and dedicated security force with the capability to defeat Level I and II threats in a joint security area. Also called MSF.
terms.definition: 기동보안부대(MSF)는 합동 보안 구역에서 1급 및 2급 위협을 격파할 수 있는 고기동성 및 전용 보안 부대를 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.english: The MSF has been rapidly deployed.
The MSF has neutralized the threat.

terms.definitionEn: A rapidly deployable, air-ground, mobile combat unit with appropriate combat support and combat service support assets assigned to, and capable of, defeating Level III threats, including combined arms. Also called TCF.
terms.definition: 전술전투부대(TCF)는 합동군 사령관의 지시에 따라 작전 지역 전체의 보안을 조정하는 책임이 있는 장교를 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: The TCF has seized the objective.
The TCF has responded swiftly.

terms.definitionEn: A specific area to facilitate protection of joint bases and their connecting lines of communications that support joint operations. Also called JSA.
terms.definition: 합동보안구역(JSA)은 합동 작전을 지원하는 합동 기지의 보호 및 연결 통신선을 용이하게 하는 특정 지역을 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: A crisis situation has occurred in the JSA.
Security in the JSA has been strengthened.

terms.definitionEn: The officer responsible for coordinating the overall security of the operational area in accordance with joint force commander directives and priorities. Also called JSC.
terms.definition: 합동보안조정관(JSC)은 합동군 사령관의 지시에 따라 작전 지역 전체의 보안을 조정하는 책임이 있는 장교를 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: The JSC is in charge of security coordination.
The JSC is conducting the situation briefing.

terms.definitionEn: A joint operations center tailored to assist the joint security coordinator in meeting the security requirements in the joint operational area. Also called JSCC.
terms.definition: 합동보안조정센터(JSCC)는 합동 보안 조정관의 보안 요구 사항을 충족하는 데 도움을 주기 위해 맞춤화된 합동 작전 센터를 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: The JSCC supports security operations.
Situation analysis is underway at the JSCC.

terms.definitionEn: A Department of Defense intelligence threat assessment of the level of terrorist threat faced by United States personnel and interests in a foreign nation; the levels are expressed as LOW, MODERATE, SIGNIFICANT, and HIGH.
terms.definition: 테러위협수준은 미국 인원과 이익이 외국에서 직면한 테러 위협 수준에 대한 국방부 정보 위협 평가이며, 수준은 LOW, MODERATE, SIGNIFICANT 및 HIGH로 표현됩니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: The terrorism threat level has increased.
We must respond according to the terrorism threat level.

terms.definitionEn: In antiterrorism, a continual process of compiling and examining all available information concerning activities by terrorist groups which could target a facility.
terms.definition: 위협분석은 시설에 대한 테러리스트 그룹의 활동을 모니터링하고 평가하는 지속적인 과정입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal reports and briefings.

examples.english: Threat analysis is complete.
We respond based on the threat analysis.

terms.definitionEn: A weapon fabricated or emplaced in an unconventional manner incorporating destructive, lethal, noxious, pyrotechnic, or incendiary chemicals. Also called IED.
terms.definition: 자작폭발물(IED)은 파괴적, 치명적, 유해한, 화학, 또는 화염성 화학 물질을 포함하는 비전통적인 방식으로 제조 또는 설치된 무기입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.english: An IED has been detected.
We have neutralized the IED.

terms.definitionEn: A device placed or fabricated in an improvised manner on a vehicle incorporating destructive, lethal, noxious, pyrotechnic, or incendiary chemicals and designed to destroy, incapacitate, harass, or distract. Also called VBIED.
terms.definition: 차량 탑재형 자작폭발물(VBIED)은 파괴적, 치명적, 유해한, 화학, 또는 화염성 화학 물질을 포함하는 차량에 설치된 또는 비전통적인 방식으로 제조된 장치로, 파괴, 무력화, 괴롭힘 또는 주의 분산을 목적으로 합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports.

examples.english: A VBIED is approaching.
We have blocked the VBIED.

terms.definitionEn: An activity that identifies and controls critical information and indicators of friendly force actions. Also called OPSEC.
terms.definition: 정보보호는 적의 공격에 대비하여 중요한 정보와 활동의 표시를 식별하고 통제하는 활동입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, orders, and training, formal register.

examples.text: OPSEC를 강화하여 적의 정보를 유출하지 마세요.
examples.english: Strengthen OPSEC to prevent information leakage to the enemy.

examples.text: OPSEC 교육을 통해 모든 병사들이 보안 수칙을 이해해야 합니다.
examples.english: All soldiers must understand security procedures through OPSEC training.

terms.definitionEn: Cross-functional working group whose purpose is to conduct risk assessment and risk management and to recommend mitigating measures to the commander. Also called FPWG.
terms.definition: 힘 보호 작업 그룹은 위험 평가와 위험 관리 수행 및 지휘관에게 완화 조치를 권장하기 위해 구성된 다기능 작업 그룹입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal military planning and liaison.

examples.text: FPWG는 주기적으로 위험평가를 수행하여 사령관에게 조치를 제안합니다.
examples.english: The FPWG regularly conducts risk assessments and recommends actions to the commander.

examples.text: FPWG는 모든 관련 부서를 포함하여 협력적으로 운영됩니다.
examples.english: The FPWG is operated collaboratively, including all relevant departments.

terms.definitionEn: Defensive measures used to reduce the vulnerability of individuals and property to terrorist acts, to include rapid containment by local military and civilian forces. Also called AT.
terms.definition: 반테러리즘은 테러 행위에 대한 취약성을 줄이고, 현지 군사 및 민간 부대의 신속한 대응을 통해 테러를 신속히 억제하는 방어 조치입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in military briefings and training materials.

examples.text: AT 대책은 테러리스트의 공격을 신속하게 진압하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
examples.english: AT measures aim to rapidly contain terrorist attacks.

examples.text: AT 교육은 모든 군사 요원에게 필수적입니다.
examples.english: AT training is mandatory for all military personnel.

terms.definitionEn: A Department of Defense Service or agency installation within the United States and its territories tasked to serve as a base for military forces engaged in either homeland defense or conducting defense support of civil authorities. Also called BSI.
terms.definition: 기지 지원 시설은 미국 본토 및 그 영토 내에 위치한 국방부 서비스의 시설로, 본토 방어 또는 민간 당국 지원에 종사하는 군사 부대를 위한 기지로서 역할을 합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and planning documents.

examples.text: BSI는 군사 작전을 지원하기 위해 다양한 시설과 서비스를 제공합니다.
examples.english: BSIs provide various facilities and services to support military operations.

examples.text: BSI는 군사 인력과 장비를 위한 기반을 제공합니다.
examples.english: BSIs provide a base for military personnel and equipment.

terms.definitionEn: In base defense operations, a locality from which operations of two or more of the Military Departments are projected or supported and which is manned by significant elements of two or more Military Departments or in which significant elements of two or more Military Departments are located.
terms.definition: 합동 기지는 두 개 이상의 군사 부서가 운영을 계획하거나 지원하며, 두 개 이상의 군사 부서가 주둔하거나 주요 요소가 위치한 지역을 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in military planning and coordination.

examples.text: 공동기지는 여러 군사 부문의 작전을 지원하는 지역입니다.
examples.english: A joint base is an area that supports operations of multiple military departments.

examples.text: 공동기지는 효율적인 자원 관리를 위해 통합적으로 운영됩니다.
examples.english: Joint bases are operated integratively for efficient resource management.

terms.definitionEn: A defense strategic intelligence assessment developed by the Defense Intelligence Agency to support combatant command planning. Also called DTA.
terms.definition: 동적 위협 평가는 국방정보국이 전략적 지능을 바탕으로 전투사령부 계획 지원 목적으로 개발한 평가입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal military intelligence reports.

examples.text: DTA는 작전에 대한 전략적 지능 평가를 지원합니다.
examples.english: DTA supports strategic intelligence assessment for operations.
DTA must be continuously updated.

terms.definitionEn: The construction of obstacles and emplacement of minefields to delay, disrupt, and destroy the enemy by reinforcement of the terrain.
terms.definition: 반기동은 장애물 건설 및 지뢰 매설로 적의 이동을 지연, 교란, 파괴하여 지형을 강화하는 것입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in military planning and briefings.

examples.text: 기동방해는 적의 움직임을 지연시키기 위해 장애물을 설치합니다.
examples.english: Countermobility sets up obstacles to delay enemy movement.
Countermobility is reinforced by terrain enhancement.

terms.definitionEn: Devices; systems; and associated tactics, techniques, and procedures designed, fielded, or employed unconventionally.
terms.definition: 즉흥적 위협은 비전통적으로 설계, 배치 또는 사용되는 장치, 시스템 및 관련 전술, 기술 및 절차입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in military intelligence and planning.

examples.english: Improvised threats are designed and used unconventionally.
Measures against improvised threats are necessary.

terms.definitionEn: Preservation of the effectiveness and survivability of mission-related military and nonmilitary personnel, equipment, facilities, information, and infrastructure deployed or located within or outside the boundaries of a given operational area.
terms.definition: 보호는 작전 지역 내외에서 배치되거나 위치한 임무 관련 군사 및 비군사 인원, 장비, 시설, 정보 및 인프라의 효과성과 생존성을 유지하는 것입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications, orders, and reports, formal register.

examples.english: Protection tasks are complete.
Wear protective gear.

terms.definitionEn: Measures to promote, improve, or conserve the behavioral and physical well-being of Service members to enable a healthy and fit force, prevent injury and illness, and protect the force from health hazards. Also called FHP.
terms.definition: 병력 건강 보호는 병사의 행동적 및 신체적 웰빙을 촉진, 개선 또는 유지하여 건강하고 적합한 병력을 확보하고, 부상과 질병을 예방하며, 병력을 건강 위험으로부터 보호하는 조치입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in military health and welfare reports.

examples.text: FHP는 군사 인력의 행동적 및 신체적 웰빙을 촉진합니다.
examples.english: FHP promotes the behavioral and physical well-being of military personnel.

examples.text: FHP는 부상과 질병을 예방하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
examples.english: FHP aims to prevent injury and illness.

terms.definitionEn: The exercise of authority and direction by a properly designated commander over assigned and attached forces in the accomplishment of the mission. Also called C2.
terms.definition: 지휘통제는 지휘관이 부대에게 임무를 수행하도록 권한과 지시를 행사하는 것을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: 지휘통제는 작전의 성공을 위해 필수적입니다. 모든 부대는 지휘통제 체계 하에 작전을 수행해야 합니다.
examples.english: Command and control is essential for the success of the operation. All units must carry out operations under the command and control system.

examples.text: 지휘통제 시스템이 작동하지 않으면 작전은 실패할 것입니다.
examples.english: If the command and control system does not function, the operation will fail.

terms.definitionEn: 1. The authority that a commander in the armed forces lawfully exercises over subordinates by virtue of rank or assignment. 2. An order given by a commander. 3. A unit or units, an organization, or an area under the authority of one individual.
terms.definition: 명령은 군대의 지휘관이 계급이나 직책에 따라 부하에게 법적으로 행사하는 권한을 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal orders and reports.

examples.text: 사령관은 부대에 명령을 내렸습니다. 모든 병사는 즉시 명령에 따라야 합니다.
examples.english: The commander issued an order to the unit. All soldiers must follow the order immediately.
The order must be clear and concise.

terms.definitionEn: 1. Authority that may be less than full command exercised by a commander over part of the activities of subordinate or other organizations. (JP 1, Volume 2) 2. In mapping, charting, and photogrammetry, a collective term for a system of marks or objects on the Earth, a map, or a photograph, whose positions or elevations (or both) have been or will be determined. (JP 2-0) 3. Physical or psychological pressures exerted with the intent to assure that an agent or group will respond as directed. (JP 3-0) 4. In intelligence usage, an indicator governing the distribution and use of documents, information, or material.
terms.definition: 통제는 지휘관이 부하 부대나 다른 조직의 일부 활동에 대한 권한을 행사하는 것을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: 작전지역에서 통제권을 확보해야 합니다. 통제권이 없으면 작전은 성공하기 어렵습니다.
examples.english: We must secure control in the operational area. Without control, it is difficult to succeed in the operation.
Control is a key element in the success of the operation.

terms.definitionEn: The authority to perform those functions of command over subordinate forces involving organizing and employing commands and forces, assigning tasks, designating objectives, and giving authoritative direction necessary to accomplish the mission. Also called OPCON.
terms.definition: OPCON은 지휘관이 부대와 조직을 구성하고 임무를 부여하며 목표를 지정하고 임무를 수행하기 위해 필요한 지시를 내릴 수 있는 권한을 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal written communication and briefings.

examples.english: We have received operational control.

examples.text: OPCON 이양에 따른 명령 체계를 확인하세요.
examples.english: Confirm the command structure following the transfer of operational control.

terms.definitionEn: The authority over forces that is limited to the detailed direction and control of movements or maneuvers within the operational area necessary to accomplish missions or tasks assigned. Also called TACON.
terms.definition: tactical control (TACON)은 작전 지역 내에서 임무를 수행하기 위해 필요한 부대의 이동이나 기동을 상세하게 지시하고 통제하는 권한을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: TACON은 작전 지역 내에서 부대의 세부적인 이동을 통제하는 권한입니다.
examples.english: TACON is the authority to control the detailed movement of units within the operational area.

examples.text: TACON 하에 작전 계획을 수립해야 합니다.
examples.english: We must develop an operational plan under TACON.

terms.definitionEn: Direction or exercise of authority over subordinate or other organizations in respect to administration and support. Also called ADCON.
terms.definition: 행정통제는 부대나 다른 조직에 대한 행정 및 지원에 관한 지시를 내리는 것을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: 행정통제는 부대 행정과 지원에 대한 권한입니다.
examples.english: Administrative control is the authority over the administration and support of units.

examples.text: 행정통제 하에 부대 행정 계획을 수립해야 합니다.
examples.english: We must develop a unit administrative plan under administrative control.

terms.definitionEn: The succession of commanding officers from a superior to a subordinate through which command is exercised.
terms.definition: 명령계통은 상위 지휘관에서 하위 지휘관으로 이어지는 계통을 통해 명령이 행사되는 것을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.english: The chain of command is a system that extends from superiors to subordinates.
Orders are passed down through the chain of command.

terms.definitionEn: A clear and concise expression of the operation’s purpose , key tasks, and military objectives or ends.
terms.definition: 지휘관의 의도는 작전의 목적, 주요 임무, 군사적 목표를 명확하고 간결하게 표현한 것입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: 지휘관의 의도는 작전의 목적과 주요 임무를 명확히 합니다.
examples.english: The commander's intent clarifies the purpose and key tasks of the operation.

examples.text: 지휘관의 의도를 기반으로 작전 계획을 수립해야 합니다.
examples.english: We must develop an operational plan based on the commander's intent.

terms.definitionEn: Specific information identified by the commander as being essential to facilitate timely decision making. Also called CCIR.
terms.definition: 지휘관의 중요정보요구사항은 지휘관이 신속한 의사 결정에 도움이 되도록 필요한 특정 정보를 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: CCIR은 지휘관의 결정에 필요한 중요한 정보를 식별합니다.
examples.english: CCIR identifies critical information needed for the commander's decision-making.

examples.text: CCIR을 기반으로 작전 정보를 수집해야 합니다.
examples.english: We must collect operational information based on CCIR.

terms.definitionEn: The conduct of military operations through decentralized execution based upon mission-type orders.
terms.definition: 임무형명령은 분산된 실행에 기반한 임무 유형의 명령에 따라 군사 작전을 수행하는 것을 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in formal briefings and reports.

examples.text: 임무형명령은 분산된 실행에 기반한 군사 작전 수행 방식입니다.
examples.english: Mission command is a way of conducting military operations through decentralized execution.

examples.text: 임무형명령을 통해 작전 계획을 수립해야 합니다.
examples.english: We must develop an operational plan through mission command.

terms.definitionEn: The direction of all forces under a single, responsible commander who has the requisite authority to direct and employ those forces.
terms.definition: 명령통일은 모든 부대가 한 명의 책임 있는 지휘관에게 보고하고, 그 지휘관이 그 부대를 지휘하고 사용할 권한을 가진 상태를 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and orders, formal register.

examples.english: Unity of command must be maintained for mission success.
All units must adhere to unity of command.

terms.definitionEn: That authority granted by a commander (any level) to a subordinate to directly consult or coordinate an action with a command or agency within or outside of the granting command. Also called DIRLAUTH.
terms.definition: 직접연락권한은 상관이 부하에게 다른 명령이나 기관과 직접 협의하거나 조정을 할 수 있는 권한을 주는 것입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in radio communications and reports, formal register.

examples.english: I have been granted direct liaison authorized, so I will contact immediately.
I am checking the situation through direct liaison authorized contact.

terms.definitionEn: The planning and synchronization of efforts that occur between elements of Department of Defense and participating United States Government departments and agencies.
terms.definition: 기관간조정은 국방부와 미국 정부 부처 및 기관 간의 계획과 조정을 통해 노력들을 조화롭게 하는 과정입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 기관간조정이 중요하므로, 모든 관련 기관과 협력해야 합니다.
examples.english: Interagency coordination is important, so we must cooperate with all relevant agencies.

examples.text: 기관간조정을 통해 효율적인 작전을 수행할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: We can carry out efficient operations through interagency coordination.

terms.definitionEn: A force composed of military elements of nations who have formed an alliance or coalition for a specific purpose. Also called MNF.
terms.definition: 다국적군은 특정 목적을 위해 동맹이나 연합을 맺은 국가들의 군대 요소가 구성된 부대를 말합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 다국적군은 다양한 국가의 군대가 협력하여 구성됩니다.
examples.english: A multinational force is composed of military forces from various nations cooperating.

examples.text: 다국적군은 국제 평화 유지를 위해 활동합니다.
examples.english: The multinational force operates to maintain international peace.

terms.definitionEn: A general term applied to a commander who exercises command authority over a military force composed of elements from two or more nations. Also called MNFC.
terms.definition: 다국적군사령관은 두 개 이상의 국가에서 온 군사 요소를 지휘하는 권한을 가진 지휘관의 일반적인 용어입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.english: The multinational force commander directs the operations of the multinational force.

examples.text: 다국적군사령관은 여러 국가의 군대를 통합 관리합니다.
examples.english: The multinational force commander integrates and manages military forces from several nations.

terms.definitionEn: Official information that has been determined to require, in the interests of national security, protection against unauthorized disclosure and which has been so designated.
terms.definition: 비밀정보는 국가 안보를 위해 비공개로 유지해야 하는 공식 정보로, 국가 안보를 위해 비공개로 지정되었습니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings, reports, and security instructions, formal register.

examples.english: Classified information must receive proper protection.

examples.text: 비밀정보를 무단으로 공개하면 큰 문제가 발생할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: Unauthorized disclosure of classified information can cause serious problems.

terms.definitionEn: In public affairs, the process of reviewing information and products prior to public release to ensure the material does not jeopardize ongoing or future operations.
terms.definition: 보안검토는 공개 전에 정보와 자료를 검토하여, 그 내용이 현재 또는 향후 작전을 위험에 빠뜨리지 않도록 하는 과정입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in public affairs and reporting, formal register.

examples.text: 보안검토를 통해 정보 유출을 방지할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: We can prevent information leaks through security review.

examples.text: 모든 자료는 보안검토를 거쳐 공개되어야 합니다.
examples.english: All materials must be reviewed through security review before release.

terms.definitionEn: A communications network that connects an echelon of command with some or all of its subordinate echelons for the purpose of command and control.
terms.definition: 명령통신망은 명령 계층과 그 하위 계층 중 일부 또는 전부를 연결하여 지휘와 통제를 위한 통신망입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in technical and operational communications, formal register.

examples.text: 명령통신망이 끊어지면 작전 지연이 발생할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: If the command net is disrupted, mission delays can occur.

examples.text: 명령통신망을 유지하기 위해 지속적인 노력이 필요합니다.
examples.english: Continuous effort is needed to maintain the command net.

terms.definitionEn: The process of fixing, observing, and reporting the location and movement of friendly forces. Also called FFT.
terms.definition: 우군추적은 우군 부대의 위치를 추적하고 관찰하여 보고하는 과정입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in operational and technical communications, formal register.

examples.text: 우군추적은 작전의 성공적인 수행을 위해 필수적입니다.
examples.english: Friendly force tracking is essential for successful mission execution.

examples.text: 우군추적을 통해 부대의 위치를 정확히 파악할 수 있습니다.
examples.english: We can accurately determine the location of units through friendly force tracking.

terms.definitionEn: A preliminary notice of an order or action, or a planning directive that initiates the development and evaluation of courses of action by a commander. Also called WARNORD.
terms.definition: 경고명령은 명령이나 조치에 대한 사전 통지 또는 계획 지침으로, 지휘관이 작전을 개발하고 평가할 수 있도록 합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and orders, formal register.

examples.text: 경고명령을 통해 작전의 개요를 미리 알 수 있습니다.
examples.english: The warning order provides an overview of the mission in advance.

examples.text: 경고명령을 받으면 즉시 작전을 계획해야 합니다.
examples.english: Upon receiving the warning order, we must immediately plan the operation.

terms.definitionEn: A planning directive that provides essential planning guidance and directs the initiation of planning but does not authorize execution. Also called ALERTORD.
terms.definition: 경고명령은 계획에 필요한 기본 지침을 제공하고 계획 시작을 지시하지만 실행은 허용하지 않는 계획 지침입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and orders, formal register.

examples.text: 경고명령이 하달되었습니다. 모든 부대는 즉시 대응을 준비하세요.
examples.english: The alert order has been issued. All units, prepare to respond immediately.
We will commence planning in accordance with the alert order.

terms.definitionEn: 1. The commander having primary responsibility for all aspects of a task assigned. 2. In the context of joint planning, the commander who prepares operation plans or operation orders in response to requirements of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. 3. In the context of a support command relationship, the commander who receives assistance from another commander, and who is responsible for ensuring the supporting commander understands the assistance required.
terms.definition: 지원받는 사령관은 주어진 임무에 대한 모든 측면에 대한 주요 책임을 지는 사령관입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in planning meetings and written reports, formal register.

examples.text: 지원받는 사령관은 작전을 주도할 책임이 있습니다.
examples.english: The supported commander has the primary responsibility for leading the operation.

examples.text: 지원받는 사령관은 작전 계획의 주요 부분을 담당합니다.
examples.english: The supported commander is responsible for the main aspects of the operation plan.

terms.definitionEn: 1. A commander who provides actions and other directed support to a supported commander. 2. In the context of a support command relationship, the commander who aids, protects, complements, or sustains another commander’s force and who is responsible for providing the assistance required by the supported commander.
terms.definition: 지원하는 사령관은 지원받는 사령관에게 조치와 기타 지원 조치를 제공하는 사령관입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and liaison, formal register.

examples.text: 지원하는 사령관은 필요한 지원 행위를 수행해야 합니다.
examples.english: The supporting commander must carry out the required supporting actions.

examples.text: 지원하는 사령관은 지원받는 사령관에게 지원을 제공합니다.
examples.english: The supporting commander provides support to the supported commander.

terms.definitionEn: A general term applied to a combatant commander, subordinate unified commander, or joint task force commander. Also called JFC.
terms.definition: 합동군사령관은 전투사령관, 하위 통합사령관 또는 합동태스크포스 사령관에 적용되는 일반 용어입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in high-level briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 합동군사령관은 여러 부대의 통합 지휘를 담당합니다.
examples.english: The joint force commander oversees the integrated command of multiple units.
The joint force commander sets the main objectives of the operation.

terms.definitionEn: A joint force that is constituted and so designated by the Secretary of Defense, a combatant commander, a subordinate unified commander, or an existing joint task force commander to accomplish a specific mission. Also called JTF.
terms.definition: 합동태스크포스는 국방부 장관, 전투사령관, 하위 통합사령관 또는 기존 합동태스크포스 사령관에 의해 특정 임무를 수행하기 위해 구성되고 지정된 합동군입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in planning and briefings, formal register.

examples.text: 합동태스크포스는 다양한 임무를 수행할 수 있도록 구성됩니다.
examples.english: The joint task force is constituted to perform various missions.

examples.text: 합동태스크포스는 특정 작전을 수행하기 위해 구성됩니다.
examples.english: The joint task force is constituted to execute specific operations.

terms.definitionEn: The interrelated responsibilities between commanders, as well as the operational authority exercised by commanders in the chain of command.
terms.definition: 지휘관계는 사령관 사이의 상호 관련 책임 및 명령 체계에서 사령관에 의해 행사되는 운영 권한을 의미합니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in written reports and briefings, formal register.

examples.text: 지휘관계는 명령의 책임과 권한을 명확히 합니다.
examples.english: Command relationships clarify the responsibilities and authority of commands.

examples.text: 지휘관계는 작전 중의 책임 소재를 규정합니다.
examples.english: Command relationships define the chain of responsibility during operations.

terms.definitionEn: In air defense, the normal mode whereby a higher echelon monitors unit actions, making direct target assignments to units only when necessary to ensure proper fire distribution or to prevent engagement of friendly aircraft.
terms.definition: 분산통제는 고위 단계가 단위 조치를 모니터링하고 적절한 화기 분배를 보장하거나 우방 항공기를 공격하는 것을 방지하기 위해 필요한 경우에만 단위에 직접적인 표적 할당을 하는 공군 방위의 정상 모드입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in air defense contexts, formal register.

examples.text: 분산통제는 각 부대가 유연하게 대응할 수 있도록 합니다.
examples.english: Decentralized control allows each unit to respond flexibly.

examples.text: 분산통제 모드에서 각 부대는 직접 목표를 할당받습니다.
examples.english: In decentralized control mode, each unit receives direct target assignments.

terms.definitionEn: In air defense, the control mode whereby a higher echelon makes direct target assignments to fire units.
terms.definition: 집중통제는 고위 단계가 화기 단위에 직접적인 표적 할당을 하는 공군 방위의 제어 모드입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in air defense briefings and radio communications by command staff.

examples.text: 집중통제가 활성화되어 있습니다. 모든 전투기는 본부 지령을 기다리세요.
examples.english: Centralized control is activated. All fighters, await headquarters' orders.

examples.text: 집중통제 하에 모든 항공기는 목표를 직접 할당받을 것입니다.
examples.english: Under centralized control, all aircraft will receive direct target assignments.

terms.definitionEn: Forces trained, equipped, and employed to understand, access, influence, and create effects within the civil component of the operational environment. Also called CA.
terms.definition: 민사행동은 훈련, 장비 및 운영 환경의 민간 구성원 내에서 이해, 접근, 영향 및 효과를 창출하기 위해 사용되는 부대입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.text: 민사행정은 민간 구성원과의 효과적인 소통이 중요합니다.
examples.english: Civil affairs requires effective communication with civilians.

examples.text: 민사행정은 작전 환경에서의 민간 영향력을 이해해야 합니다.
examples.english: Civil affairs must understand the influence of civilians in the operational environment.

terms.definitionEn: Communication activities with external and internal audiences. Also called PA.
terms.definition: 공보는 외부 및 내부 청중과 소통하는 활동입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in briefings and reports, formal register.

examples.english: Public affairs handles effective communication with external audiences.
Public affairs also emphasizes communication with internal members.

terms.definitionEn: Public affairs activities that support the relationship between military and civilian communities.
terms.definition: 지역사회 참여는 군과 민간 공동체가 서로 신뢰를 쌓고 협력할 수 있도록 지원하는 공공 관계 활동입니다.
terms.registerNote: Used in public affairs contexts, formal.
